institution: The University of Texas Rio Grande Valley

app_fee.value: Most UTRGV graduate programs—including all 5 STEM Ph.D. programs—do not require an application fee (only six health-professions programs charge $50 domestic / $100 international).
app_fee.quote: Most of our graduate programs currently do not require an application fee. | Below is a list of the programs with an application fee: Communication Sciences and Disorders (COMD) Family Nurse Practitioner (Post Master's Certificate) Occupational Therapy (OTD) Physician Assistant Studies (MPAS) Physical Therapy (DPT) Psychiatric/Mental Health Nurse Practitioner Certificate Program

fee_waiver.value: No application fee is charged for UTRGV STEM Ph.D. programs, so no fee waiver is needed.
fee_waiver.quote: Most of our graduate programs currently do not require an application fee.

gre_general.value: GRE General requirements and waivers vary by department (required with GPA waivers for CS and Materials Science & Engineering; optional for Physics; unstated for Human Genetics and Mathematics & Statistics).

toefl_min.value: Minimum TOEFL score is 79 Internet-Based (550 Paper-Based, 213 Computer-Based; or 8.5 TOEFL Essentials; Duolingo 105; PTE Academic 45); institution code 6570.
toefl_min.quote: TOEFL (Test of English as a Foreign Language) Paper-Based: 550 Computer-Based: 213 Internet-Based: 79

ielts_min.value: Minimum IELTS Academic overall score is 6.5.

english_waiver.value: An English-medium degree from India does not waive the English proficiency exam under UTRGV's country table (India: English Test Required = Yes); exemptions require an exempt country, 30 credit hours in an exempt country, or UTRGV ELP Advanced Level.
english_waiver.quote: Country English Test Required Minimum Degree | India Yes 4-year bachelor; 3-year bachelor + master or 3-year bachelor + post-grad diploma

also.quote: Visit the English Proficiency Exam and Degree Requirements by Country page to check if your country qualifies for an exemption. | Completion of at least 30 credit hours of university-level coursework in an exempt country.

notes: UTRGV lists 8 Ph.D. programs officially: 5 STEM Ph.D. programs covered here (Computer Science with Interdisciplinary Applications, Human Genetics, Materials Science and Engineering, Mathematics and Statistics with Interdisciplinary Applications, and Physics) plus 3 non-STEM Ph.D.s excluded (Business Administration, Clinical Psychology, Rehabilitation Counseling). International applicants must submit a course-by-course foreign credential evaluation (WES, FCSA, SPANTRAN, or IEE).
